name: Kumagaya Shino
source:
She grew up as a young lady from a wealthy family. She met her [url=/c150424]husband[/url] at a party with other schools when she was in college, and they became involved in a relationship.

She has few friends and feels lonely in an environment where she does not know anyone since she left her hometown. 

She is the type to compare herself to the heroines of tv dramas, and easily gets swept away with the situations and circumstances found in the show.

She finds pleasure in the idea of being in similar situations found in tv dramas due to her sense of immorality and guilt.
